focus: Apple -3.8% premarket: December gross margin guided to 45-46% on 'unprecedented' memory costs
Memory jumps on that read-through: SanDisk +4.6%, Micron +3.7%, SK Hynix ADR +2.8%; SMH +2.4%
Software sold again: Shopify -15.2% (GMV miss), Palantir -6.3% (bookings +6%); IGV -1.3%
Eaton +1.8% after beating and raising (organic +19%); Fabrinet +8.4% on a big guide
Midterm voting today, results tonight; oil firm after a U.S. strike on Iran's Qeshm Island (WTI 97.11)
AMD (±8.7% priced by Wednesday), SMCI, ANET and ALAB report after the close; JOLTS 10:00 ET
bigPicture: The market pays for pricing power and punishes anyone absorbing costs or slowing down: memory makers rise on Apple's cost warning while Apple's own margin guide falls short.
Growth at any multiple is not enough for software: Palantir beat and raised and Shopify beat on profit, yet both drop on one slowing number (bookings, GMV). IGV is -8.5% in five days.
Chips are bouncing inside a correction (Nasdaq-100 in its third correction this year, SMH -19.8% in a month); AMD tonight is the first real test of whether the bounce has earnings behind it.
Rates and oil set the ceiling: the 10-year near 4.89%, a December 9 hike still the base case (~75-85% per the Movers Report), and oil swinging on each Iran headline.
snapshot.takeaway: Today pays the sellers of scarce inputs (memory, power gear, optics) and punishes those who pay for them or are slowing down (Apple, software). The broad market is flat ahead of election results and AMD tonight, so let the 10:00 JOLTS print and the first 15 minutes confirm a direction before trusting either side.
